mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS shows a 3-month decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 70% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when PAYEMS shows a 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows down to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) declines, it signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO declines
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when GDPC1 growth is < 1% QoQ and INDPRO declines.
